description: Translate the remaining docs/plans CN content for 2026-03-* and the global plan logs (findings.md, progress.md). About 8 files in this batch. Same plan-file structure as the 2026-02 batch in FEAT-006.
steps: Identify remaining files: `grep -l -P '[\x{4e00}-\x{9fff}]' docs/plans/2026-03-*.md docs/plans/findings.md docs/plans/progress.md 2>/dev/null > /tmp/plans-2026-03-cjk.txt`. Expected files: 2026-03-04-autonomous-agent-loop.md, 2026-03-04-kiro-code-intelligence-integration.md, 2026-03-04-openviking-integration.md, 2026-03-04-ov-auto-sync-recall.md, 2026-03-04-ov-auto-sync-recall.progress.md, 2026-03-04-reasoning-loop-coarse-checklist.md, 2026-03-31-evaluator.md, findings.md, progress.md.
Translate each file. Preserve fenced code blocks, identifiers, paths, citation URLs, the `**Verdict: APPROVE**` / `**Verdict: REQUEST CHANGES**` literals where they exist, and emoji.
For docs/plans/findings.md and docs/plans/progress.md (cumulative agent logs): keep timestamps verbatim, keep the file/line refs and SHAs verbatim, translate the explanatory prose under each entry.

After this batch, run the FINAL audit: `find . -name '*.md' -type f -not -path './.git/*' -not -path './.agents/*' -not -path './.pytest_cache/*' -not -path './tests/knowledge/fixtures/*' -exec grep -l -P '[\x{4e00}-\x{9fff}]' {} \; | sort > /tmp/cjk-final.txt`. Result MUST be EMPTY (no remaining CJK in any non-fixture .md file). If non-empty, list each leftover and resolve them BEFORE committing this batch. NOTE: the README.md flowchart code block and the commands/do.md code block contain legitimate Chinese inside fenced code blocks - those are EXCLUDED from this audit because the audit looks for any CJK in a file. So the audit may flag README.md and commands/do.md; verify each flagged file's CJK is INSIDE a fenced code block by `awk` chunking (toggle a fence flag at every ```` line). The genuinely-final list of files allowed to remain CJK-bearing AFTER this pass is: README.md (in-fence demo), commands/do.md (in-fence demo). If any other file appears, fix it.

Verify all 9 test-anchored literals one last time across the whole tree: `for lit in 'Coding agent' 'GTM' 'Evidence before claims' 'Skill Routing' 'Authority Matrix' 'episodes.md' 'BEGIN OMK PRINCIPLES' '**Verdict: APPROVE**' '**Verdict: REQUEST CHANGES**'; do count=$(grep -r -F -l "$lit" --include='*.md' . 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); echo "$count files: $lit"; done`. Each count must be >= 1.

Verify no em dashes added in translated lines: `git diff main HEAD -- '*.md' | grep '^+' | grep -F -- '—'` should be empty (any pre-existing em dash that survives is on a `^-` -> `^+` round-trip, but newly-added em dashes are forbidden).
Run the full verification suite: pytest with the documented ignore set, `bash tests/test-agents-template.sh`, `bash tests/knowledge/run.sh`. All counts must match baseline exactly.

Write a final audit summary to .agents/tasks/task-translate-cn-ptbr/audit.md listing: total files translated, files left with in-fence CN demos (README.md, commands/do.md), confirmation of the 9 test-anchored literals, baseline test counts.

Stage and commit with message: `docs(i18n): translate 2026-03 plans + global logs CN -> pt-BR + final audit`. Final commit `git diff --stat main` should list every translated .md file from FEAT-002 onward plus all .agents/tasks/task-translate-cn-ptbr/ artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: Every docs/plans/2026-03-*.md and findings.md/progress.md file has zero CJK characters.
Final audit grep across the repo (excluding .git, .agents, .pytest_cache, tests/knowledge/fixtures) returns AT MOST 2 files: README.md and commands/do.md (both due to legitimate in-fence demos).
All 9 test-anchored literals appear at least once in the repo after this pass.
No em dashes were added in any newly-translated line (per the +/- diff check).
Baseline test counts unchanged: pytest 60p/8f, agents-template 27p/1f, knowledge 1/3.
verification: Run the final audit grep and confirm the result is at most 2 files (README.md, commands/do.md): `find . -name '*.md' -type f -not -path './.git/*' -not -path './.agents/*' -not -path './.pytest_cache/*' -not -path './tests/knowledge/fixtures/*' -exec grep -l -P '[\x{4e00}-\x{9fff}]' {} \; | sort > /tmp/cjk-final.txt && wc -l /tmp/cjk-final.txt && cat /tmp/cjk-final.txt`.

Run `for lit in 'Coding agent' 'GTM' 'Evidence before claims' 'Skill Routing' 'Authority Matrix' 'episodes.md' 'BEGIN OMK PRINCIPLES' '**Verdict: APPROVE**' '**Verdict: REQUEST CHANGES**'; do n=$(grep -r -F -l "$lit" --include='*.md' . 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); [ "$n" -ge 1 ] || echo MISSING_AFTER_PASS: $lit; done` - prints nothing.
Run `git diff main HEAD -- '*.md' | grep '^+' | grep -F -- '—' | grep -v '^+++'` - returns nothing.
Run pytest with the documented ignore set - tail must contain `8 failed, 60 passed`.
Run `bash tests/test-agents-template.sh` - must end with `Results: 27 passed, 1 failed`.
Run `bash tests/knowledge/run.sh 2>&1 | tail -10` - must contain `Scripts: 1 pass / 3 total`.
Confirm .agents/tasks/task-translate-cn-ptbr/audit.md exists and lists the final state.
